leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a basic Node.js server to handle HTTP requests and WebSocket connections.
Implement a publish-subscribe pattern using a simple in-memory event bus.
Configure WebSocket connections to subscribe to specific event channels.
Integrate HTTP endpoints to publish events that broadcast to subscribed WebSocket clients.
Manipulate client connections to manage subscriptions and handle disconnections.
Initialize and control the flow of real-time messages between publishers and subscribers.
Apply error handling to manage connection failures and malformed messages.
lessonTitle: Build pub sub bridge for realtime events
